text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the one-way operation on Gloucester Street, between Yonge Street and Gloucester Lane, as it relates to the site plan control application for 587-599 Yonge Street. This proposal will provide residents and visitors accessing the new building's retail stores, commercial offices and commercial parking garage direct access off of Yonge Street and addresses area residents' concerns regarding cut-through traffic on Gloucester Street.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing one-way westbound designation on Gloucester Street, between Yonge Street and Gloucester Lane.
